'''Janice''' was an employee of the [[Vault-Tec Corporation]] before the [[Great War]] in the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]].

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Wrangler]]===
Janice's skeletal remains can be found sitting at her desk in the [[Vault-Tec headquarters (TV series)|Vault-Tec headquarters]].

==Personality==
According to [[Pete (TV series)|Pete]], she always was a kiss-ass.
